name: Defines OS Group
description: This host's own account database defines this group: the /etc/group entry or Windows local group lives on the host. Containment: the group exists only as part of the host, so it retires when the host does (computing_core__host lists this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES). Exactly one per os_group, drawn to the host whose spine natural key (host_type|stable_id) is the os_group's tap.computing.host dimension.
